findings.description: CON-SUP-107 and CON-SUP-124 specify the CRC polynomial but not its initial value, reflection, final XOR or stored-reference byte order. Different choices can produce different comparison results for the same image, so the expected result is not uniquely verifiable.
findings.requested_change: Resolve the CRC parameters and reference byte order in OP-SYS-014, then state or precisely reference them in the requirement.

findings.description: The run-time CRC comparison lacks the initial value, reflection, final XOR and reference byte order. CON-SUP-124 specifies only the polynomial and reference location, so the expected comparison result is not unique.
findings.requested_change: Resolve the CRC parameters and reference byte order in OP-SYS-014, then state or precisely reference them in the requirement.

findings.description: The requirement reports SAFE from fault detection, although STK-SUP-009 and CON-SUP-105 allow safe-state entry up to 50 ms later. It also applies to a watchdog-reset fault report, although SYS-SUP-027 identifies code 8 as reported after reset without entering the safe state. The cited sources do not establish these state selections.
findings.requested_change: Obtain and record the intended status-state transition and precedence rules, including the interval before safe-state entry and watchdog-reset reporting, then align the requirement with that decision.
